result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render correctly. The only visually broken element is the circular button in the top-right corner, whose icon/avatar failed to render, leaving an empty gray circle with a stray red notification dot. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll behaviors and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (next to the 'DELIVER TO' address block) shows only a light gray placeholder circle with a small red notification dot; the expected icon or avatar image inside it is missing, making the control look broken and its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon or user avatar inside the circular button (e.g., bell or profile icon), and verify the image/icon asset loads; keep the red dot only as a badge overlaying a visible icon.

issues.description: Because the top-right circular button displays no visible glyph or label, its function cannot be identified visually, which also suggests it may lack an accessible name for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable icon plus an accessibility label (e.g., 'Notifications') to the button so sighted and assistive-technology users can understand its purpose.
